summary: Payroll Engine testing complete. All features working correctly: 1) LOP calculation uses actual days in month (31 for March, 28 for Feb, 30 for April), 2) HR Test Mode simulation shows earnings/deductions with formulas, 3) Run Payroll creates draft register, 4) Payroll Register shows employee-wise breakdown, 5) Approval workflow (HR Manager → Admin) functional with history tracking.
seed_data_creation: Payroll register created for 2026-03 during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll Engine fully functional. All 4 tabs working: HR Test Mode, Run Payroll, Payroll Register, Approval. LOP calculation correctly uses actual days in month.

payroll_engine_page_loads.details: Page loads at /payroll-engine with title 'Payroll Engine' and subtitle 'Field-level traceable payroll calculations with approval workflow'

hr_test_mode_employee_dropdown.details: Employee dropdown shows all employees (EMP001-EMP005) with name and department

hr_test_mode_lop_calculation.details: LOP calculation uses actual days in month: March=31 days, Feb=28 days, April=30 days. Formula: (Gross / Actual Days) × LOP Days

hr_test_mode_earnings_breakdown.details: Shows Basic Salary (40%), HRA (20%), Special Allowance (40%) with formulas

hr_test_mode_deductions_with_formulas.details: Shows LOP (with daily rate), PF (12% of min(Basic, ₹15,000)), PT (slab-based) with full formulas

run_payroll_creates_draft.details: POST /api/payroll/engine/run creates draft register with employee calculations

payroll_register_employee_breakdown.details: Table shows Employee, Department, Gross, LOP, PF, Other Ded., Net Payable with totals

approval_workflow_status.details: Shows workflow: Draft → HR Review → Admin Approve → Locked with history tracking

field_level_traceability.details: Each calculation includes input_values, formula_used, output_value, rule_id, rule_version

lop_calculation_verification.formula: (Gross Monthly / Actual Days in Month) × LOP Days
